name: resonite_session_management
description: Manage Resonite sessions, worlds, and social interactions

session_name.description: Name for the session (for start action)

world_path.description: World path to load (for load_world action)

avatar_path.description: Avatar path to load (for load_avatar action)

script_name.description: Script name to execute (for execute_script action)

template: Perform {action} action in Resonite session. Session: {session_name}, World: {world_path}, Avatar: {avatar_path}, Parameter: {parameter_name}={parameter_value}, Script: {script_name}.

examples.output: Start a new Resonite session called 'MyCreativeSession' and load the TutorialWorld.
Set the Happy parameter to 0.9 in the current Resonite session.
Execute the 'EnvironmentSetup' ProtoFlux script in the current Resonite session.
